issue.title: Stabilize test_frontmatter_panel_populated_png_snapshot
issue.description: On 2026-08-13, an isolated strict visual run on current HEAD fails test_frontmatter_panel_populated_png_snapshot and five sibling frontmatter-panel nodes (error, cell_edit, ghost_row, raw_diagnostics, saved_feedback) with the same exact 325 changed/material-pixel signature. The snippet-pane-frame diff does not affect solo prompt panes or frontmatter styling, and restoring the unrelated update-mode rewrites makes all six failures reproduce unchanged against HEAD. Diagnose and pin the shared alpha/rendering source for these six nodes, preserving exact local pixel equality rather than blindly accepting drift. Retired umbrella sase-dl forbids another broad +1, so this is the required node-specific follow-up.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-dl — retired broad-drift umbrella; this task narrows the work to one reproducible six-node signature.

Triage sweep 2026-08-14 (requested by the project owner: keep the seven highest-impact open tasks, close the rest). These are per-node visual-snapshot stabilizations (artifacts/beads provider inventory, frontmatter panel, preview panel reference, the low-alpha xterm-256 palette audit) plus the just test-visual-update blast-radius defect. The PNG suite is excluded from 'just test' and 'just test-cov', so none of these blocks the shared check/check-full gates, and today's 'tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake' run names 12 reproducible flakes, none of them a PNG node. The update-mode hazard in sase-lo is real but mitigated by review discipline (goldens land in a diff). Re-file with a +1 if a golden mismatch blocks a landing.

payload.close_reason: Deprioritized in the 2026-08-14 task-backlog triage: PNG-golden drift is contained by the dedicated just test-visual lane and is not blocking the shared gates.
